Set to true to deploy an IBM-managed CNPG (PostgreSQL) cluster for WDU.
Set to false to connect WDU to your own external PostgreSQL.
When true: HOSTNAME, USERNAME, and PASSWORD are auto-derived from the CNPG cluster.
When false: fill in HOSTNAME, PORT, DATABASE_NAME, USERNAME, PASSWORD below.
Only required when USE_IBM_CNPG=false (external / BYO PostgreSQL).

Enable SSL for the WDU PostgreSQL connection.
When USE_IBM_CNPG=true SSL is always enabled (sslmode=verify-ca).
SSL mode for the WDU PostgreSQL connection.
Only used when USE_IBM_CNPG=false and SSL_ENABLED=true.
Place CA cert in ssl-certs/wdu/serverca/ for verify-ca or verify-full.
Place client cert+key in ssl-certs/wdu/clientcert/ and clientkey/ for mTLS.
Number of PostgreSQL instances in the WDU CNPG cluster (primary + replicas).
Use 1 for development, 3 for production HA.
PVC storage size per PostgreSQL instance for WDU.
Storage class name for WDU PVCs (must support ReadWriteMany).
